digo_source: Mgombato ('kapu lemon', 'limau lemon'); Pakia ('Mlimau / Mkapu' shared by all Digo)

teaser.en: Digo has two words for the lemon, *limau* and *kapu*, and both are understood by Digo speakers everywhere.
teaser.sw: Kidigo kina maneno mawili ya limau, *limau* na *kapu*, na yote mawili yanaeleweka na wazungumzaji wa Kidigo kila mahali.
teaser.dg: Chidigo china maneno mairi ga limau, *limau* na *kapu*, na gosi mairi ganamanyikana ni atu osi anaogomba Chidigo kosi.

summary.en: *Mlimau* or *mkapu* is the lemon tree, grown beside homesteads for its large yellow fruit. Its juice goes into drinks and into everyday cooking.
summary.sw: *Mlimau* au *mkapu* ni mlimau, unaopandwa kando ya makazi kwa ajili ya matunda yake makubwa ya manjano. Maji yake hutiwa katika vinywaji na katika mapishi ya kila siku.
summary.dg: *Mlimau* au *mkapu* ni muhi wa malimau, unaophandwa kanda-kanda ya midzi kpwa sababu ya matundage makulu ga manjano. Madzige ganahumirwa kpwenye vinwadzi na kpwenye kujita kpwa chila siku.

about.en: The lemon is a small citrus tree with glossy, pointed leaves and, often, a few sharp thorns on the twigs. Its white flowers are sweetly scented. The fruit is larger than a lime and ripens to bright yellow, with a sour, juicy flesh and an aromatic skin.
about.sw: Mlimau ni mti mdogo wa jamii ya machungwa wenye majani yanayong'aa na yenye ncha kali, na mara nyingi miiba michache mikali kwenye vitawi. Maua yake meupe yana harufu tamu. Tunda lake ni kubwa kuliko ndimu na huiva kuwa la manjano angavu, lenye nyama chachu yenye maji mengi na ganda lenye harufu nzuri.
about.dg: *Mlimau* ni muhi mdide wa jamii ya ndimu, wenye makodza ganaala genye ntsa, na mara nyinji miya michache mikali kpwenye mapanda madide. Maruwage ga rangi nyereru gana arufu nono ya mtswano. Tunda ni kulu kuriko ndimu na rinaivwa kukala ra manjano rinaroala, na nyama ya ngbwadu yenye madzi manji na gada renye arufu nono.

where.en: Lemon trees are kept close to the house, in homesteads and home gardens along the south coast, alongside limes and oranges.
where.sw: Milimau hupandwa karibu na nyumba, katika makazi na bustani za nyumbani kando ya pwani ya kusini, pamoja na midimu na michungwa.
where.dg: Milimau inaphandwa phephi na nyumba, midzini na kpwenye busitani za kaya kanda-kanda ya pwani ya kusini, phamwenga na midimu na michungwa.

uses.en: The juice is squeezed into drinks and used in cooking.
uses.sw: Maji yake hukamuliwa ndani ya vinywaji na hutumika katika mapishi.
uses.dg: Madzige nkuminywa kpwenye vinwadzi na nkuhumirwa kujitira.

names.en: The tree is *mlimau* or *mkapu*, and the fruit *limau* or *kapu*. Both names are shared by all Digo speakers. Swahili uses *mlimau* for the tree and *limau* for the fruit. In English it is lemon.
names.sw: Mti ni *mlimau* au *mkapu*, na tunda ni *limau* au *kapu*. Majina yote mawili yanatumiwa na wazungumzaji wote wa Kidigo. Kiswahili hutumia *mlimau* kwa mti na *limau* kwa tunda. Kwa Kiingereza ni *lemon*.
names.dg: Muhi ni *mlimau* au *mkapu*, na tunda ni *limau* au *kapu*. Madzina gosi mairi nkuhumirwa ni atu osi anaogomba Chidigo. Kpwa Chiswahili muhi ni *mlimau* na tunda ni *limau*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *lemon*.

reason.en: Same genus; the smaller, sourer lime
reason.sw: Jenasi moja; ndimu, ndogo na chachu zaidi
reason.dg: Jenasi mwenga; ndimu, ndide na ya ngbwadu zaidi

definition.en: A lemon; another Mgombato word alongside limau.
definition.sw: Limau; neno lingine la Mgombato pamoja na limau.
definition.dg: Tunda ra mlimau; neno ranjina ra Mgombato phamwenga na *limau*.

sources: Mwalonya, Nicolle, Nicolle & Zimbu, Mgombato: Digo-English-Swahili Dictionary (BTL / Digo Language and Literacy Project, 2004; e-version 2005)
